question: When a play trigger fires, can I respond with a reaction?
assumptions: RiftJudge p0029 — abstract question about on-play triggers and reactability. The bridge's rules-demo on-play topic explains: play-triggers go on the chain (rule 322.1 / 555), so the opponent CAN respond with a Reaction before the triggered ability resolves; only the resolution of that trigger may be interrupted, the fact of the play already happened.
